remarks: Renovated old world charm in the heart of central Greenwich! Three bedrooms, plus office, eat in kitchen with granite countertops, and new stainless steel appliances, newly finished hardwood floors throughout. New Mitsubishi hyper heat condensers and blowers. Two off street parking spaces, own washer dryer, great storage in basement and huge walk up attic. Minutes to train, shops, restaurants, I95 and beach!
